topic: GTA 6 pre-load is live since Nov 10

topic_score.why: Every digital buyer has to download the game before launch day, and it is a very big download.

title: GTA 6 pre-load is LIVE, and it is HUGE...
description: GTA 6 digital pre-load on PS5 started at midnight local time on November 10, after Rockstar moved it forward from November 12. It needs up to 212 GB of free space. Pre-loading does not let you play early: Rockstar says GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on November 19.

lines.say: GTA 6 pre-load is already live, and it started earlier than planned. Here's why.
Digital pre-load on PS5 started at midnight local time on November 10.

beats.text: Digital pre-load on PS5 started at midnight local time on November 10.
beats.label: Confirmed

lines.say: On Xbox, pre-load reportedly opened at midnight GMT on November 10.
If you saw November 12, that date is old. Rockstar moved it forward to November 10.
November 12 is now when boxed copies arrive in shops.
The download needs up to 212 gigabytes of free space.
But here's the catch. Pre-loading does not let you play early.
Rockstar says GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time on November 19.
